rows.grounds: fused form vijayam + ca; accusative object of hearing

items.question: What response does Sri Lalita Ambika give upon hearing of victory?
premises: Victory is heard by the goddess.
items.inference: Sri Lalita Ambika becomes pleased after hearing of victory.
uncertainties: The exact case and syntactic role of vijayañca depend on the fused sandhi form.
items.plain_english: Then, hearing of victory, Sri Lalita Ambika is pleased.
